name: On-delay normally-open contact
summary: An on-delay NO contact changes from its unoperated open state only after the associated timing condition has persisted for the documented delay.
description: An on-delay NO contact changes from its unoperated open state only after the associated timing condition has persisted for the documented delay. The contact tag links it to the timer element.
readingNotes: The delay applies to the indicated operating transition, not automatically to both directions.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A timed contact adds transition information to the basic normally-open state.
